matrix_source.registry_note: This branch expanded the earlier 294-case registry by 8 NextSeg×PSI combinations and 10 FastResponse historical conditions; the result ledger contains 312 rows in W01-W47.

current_comparison.interpretation: Full-matrix outcomes were generated on the older 2bb72a3 source; use them for failure patterns and historical comparison, not as validation of current fixes.

cpp_refusals.group_observation: All 16 recorded refusals are Classic, N1, phase 4/reason 1, attributed in the result rows to unresolved amplitude overshoot at ResistanceMax; these rows include repeated conditions and are not 16 distinct root causes.

interpretation_limits: not_converged_at_stop means the configured stop was reached with Need=1; it does not establish algorithmic impossibility.
Training convergence, target detection, and separation quality are separate outcomes.
PSI and duration aggregates are descriptive only; the matrix factors are not balanced for causal comparisons.
W47 intended manual Rs=20M was reset to 86M before training by SoftCold preparation; W47 is not a valid test of the intended initial-Rs or old-Rmin condition.

source_provenance_summary.note: Root/Bin gitlinks moved forward between waves as results and documentation were committed; all result manifests report the same PulseLib trainer source hashes and same source hashes for other tracked files, with two Console binaries.
